note: Unlike B3_25D where decision-config was NOT_RECOVERED, this config is independently sealed before any GPU matrix training. It defines the exact rules for PASS/HOLD decisions on V4 viability results.

primary_decision_rule.description: V4 detector PASSES viability if it demonstrates Pareto improvement over close-only baseline on at least 3 of 4 folds with matched operating points, AND all hard gates pass.

full_t10_hit_at_matched_fpr_10pct.description: At matched negative-episode any-emit = 10%, V4 full-T10 hit rate must be >= close baseline at the same operating point.

negative_episode_any_emit_at_matched_rec.description: At matched full-T10 = 95%, V4 negative any-emit must be strictly less than close baseline.

later_event_hit_lower_bound.description: Later-event hit rate must not crash below 80% at any viable operating point.

pareto_folds_minimum.description: At least 3 of 4 folds must show a Pareto-improving operating point.

score_close_correlation_max.description: Pearson correlation between V4 criticality score and close streak must be below 0.95. Above this, the model is essentially a close detector.

seed_std_max.description: Standard deviation of full-T10 hit across 3 seeds within each fold must be <= 0.05.

decision_outcomes.PASS: All hard gates pass AND all metric thresholds met. Detector demonstrates Pareto improvement over close baseline.
decision_outcomes.HOLD_MARGINAL: Hard gates pass but some metric thresholds not met. Detector shows promise but insufficient evidence. DO NOT proceed to FIT-DEV.
decision_outcomes.HOLD_FAIL: Hard gates fail OR metrics far below thresholds. Detector does not demonstrate value over close baseline.
decision_outcomes.HOLD_INCOMPLETE: Not all runs completed or seals not verified.
